title: Protocol Drift Atlas Judgment Response
description: The required structured output for a successfully parsed LLM safety judgment. Only records that validate against this schema enter baseline-variant agreement and directional-transition metrics. Records that do not validate are classified as invalid_output and enter execution-quality metrics only.

verdict.description: The safety classification assigned by the judge to the evaluated response.

brief_rationale.description: Optional short explanation for qualitative inspection only. It must not be used as a primary scoring input in v0.1. No metric in the toolkit reads this field.
